selection_reasoning: These two 'find' tasks form a coherent multi-hop navigation challenge. The dependency is structured so that the player must first locate a lapis block, which serves as a landmark/waypoint leading toward the emerald block. This creates a sequential exploration task where finding the first block provides visual or positional information needed to locate the second. Both tasks are observable (distinctive colored blocks), verifiable (player proximity/line-of-sight), and require no deep crafting knowledge. The scene can be designed so the lapis block is visible from spawn and the emerald block is hidden behind or near the lapis block area, creating a natural navigation chain.

edges.reason: Lapis block serves as a waypoint; emerald block is placed beyond/behind it, requiring the player to first navigate to the lapis block area to discover the emerald block's location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the lapis lazuli pillar (3 blocks tall at spawn-relative 8,1,8). max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walks to the pillar rather than just spotting it from spawn (~11.3 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the block when nearby, modeling that they have 'found' it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The emerald pillar (3 blocks tall at spawn-relative 17,1,15) is hidden behind a stone brick wall (14-16, 0-3, 13-16). max_distance=8 ensures the player has navigated around the wall — from the lapis pillar at (8,1,8) the emerald is ~11.4 blocks away, so the player must move closer. The wall blocks direct line-of-sight from spawn, forcing navigation around it. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the emerald block.

scene_description: A flat grass plain with a 3-block-tall lapis lazuli pillar visible from spawn as a waypoint, a stone brick wall structure behind it that occludes a 3-block-tall emerald pillar on the far side. The player must first navigate to the lapis pillar, then explore around the stone brick wall to discover the emerald.
task_text: Find the blue lapis block pillar, then navigate around the stone brick wall to find the hidden green emerald block pillar behind it.
design_notes: Lapis pillar at (8,0-2,8) is ~11.3 blocks from spawn and clearly visible. Stone brick wall at (14-16, 0-3, 13-16) occludes the emerald pillar at (17,0-2,15) from the spawn direction. Player must navigate past lapis, then around the wall to discover emerald. The interior air pocket in the wall adds visual interest but doesn't affect gameplay.
